applicabilityBasis.summary: XGZ references one gram of physical gold and provides conditional gold-bar redemption. Gold is not national-currency monetary value under GENIUS Act section 2(17), so the token does not satisfy the fixed-monetary-value payment-stablecoin definition in section 2(22).

references.label: GENIUS Act section 2(22) payment stablecoin definition
GoldZip terms: gold-bar redemption and no cash-value claim

genius.notes: XGZ represents one gram of physical gold and provides conditional gold-bar redemption. GoldZip terms identify GoldZip Digital Pte Ltd as the Singapore administrator and redemption counterparty, while the homepage and litepaper describe issuance by a Hong Kong Gold Exchange group member company without unequivocally naming that incorporated issuing company. issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted rather than equating administration with legal issuance. This does not affect the sourced gold-unit scope finding. No GENIUS authorization is asserted.
